answer: Each new agent identity must lock a copper-denominated bond before earning grading or vote weight. The bond sits on a hard ledge: below that stake threshold the identity can only observe, never move consensus. Farms then pay linearly per fake head, and a detected cluster burns every linked bond. A short sonnet of free-form text does not replace the stake—peers attest only when the lock is live and the mechanism explanation is concrete about attacker cost.
